title: I Made 7-player Tic-Tac-Toe
author: MosesSecondofHisName
selftext:
I was really inspired by [this 8-player survival Pong](https://www.reddit.com/r/aigamedev/comments/1vmdx2q/8player_survival_pong_built_with_opus_the_arena/) by u/Nehekhara, and I decided to make 7-player Tic-Tac-Toe, complete with a Rubik's Cube style rotating board, some fun Mario Kart-esque powerups, and ranked play (eventually). Each face of the cube, you're playing against another player. I had a lot of fun building it and testing it and it's now open for testing on Android (coming to iPhone soon) at the link below:

[Download Link](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.clqgaming.quiktactoe)

For my work flow, I basically did all my ideation and brainstorming in GPT. As I started to feel like I'd worked out the game's systems, I had GPT design a game bible, then I took that over to Codex (I built this mostly with Sol 5.6 and Sol 6.1) and had Codex basically interrogate me about the game until we'd worked out all the holes and inconsistencies.

Then I got to building. Codex handled all the implementation; graphics mostly came from GPT; audio came from a combo of Pixabay, Suno, and some I made/tweaked with Audible and Codex.

If you have any questions, feel free to ask! And if you get a chance to play it, please let me know what you think. It's still in development, so everything can be improved.
